portInfo.description: Cagliari occupies Sardinia’s southern shore, with its old fortified district above a much larger living city. Phoenician-Punic and Roman layers sit beneath Pisan fortifications and later Aragonese and Savoy-era changes. The useful contrast on a cruise day is between narrow elevated Castello streets and the open coast at Poetto; trying to cover both plus a remote archaeological excursion can make an easy-looking stop unnecessarily rushed.

gettingThere.fromTerminal: Rinascita Pier — West Quay — Molo Rinascita,Cagliari
gettingThere.distanceToCity: At Rinascita, follow the line’s controlled route to its port shuttle and public gate. Allow 30–45 minutes from gangway to the lower city, including waiting; then budget another 20–30 minutes uphill to Castello, or a taxi if mobility/heat makes climbing unsuitable. These are planning allowances, not measured road times. The operator describes the town as 800 m away but does not define the endpoints; do not turn that into a gangway-to-cathedral walking distance. Poetto requires a separate bus/taxi decision and a return pickup. Airport and intercity rail transfers should be planned separately from this shore-day loop.
gettingThere.publicTransport: Confirm local transport options with the ship on your call date.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Castello historic quarter, Via Stretta, Castello, Cagliari: Use the named lane as a specific stop within the hill district, then explore the fortified streets. Allow about 75 minutes (editorial estimate). Steep stone surfaces; not a step-free route.

Cathedral of Santa Maria, Cathedral of Santa Maria, Castello, Cagliari: The cathedral shows successive architectural changes rather than one untouched medieval style. Allow about 40 minutes (editorial estimate). Dress for a place of worship; services affect visitor access.

Poetto beach, Marina Piccola end of Poetto, Cagliari: A coastal alternative to a museum-heavy day, with time to sit rather than rush the whole shoreline. Allow about 120 minutes (editorial estimate). Use a specific return pickup; swimming depends on conditions.

Temporary San Benedetto market at Piazza Nazzari, Piazza Amedeo Nazzari, Via Sant’Alenixedda beside Teatro Lirico, Cagliari: Meet the traders in the temporary market rather than assuming the old San Benedetto hall is operating normally. Allow about 60 minutes (editorial estimate). Opening notice dated 18 March 2025; reconfirm current working days and layout.

Orto dei Cappuccini, Orto dei Cappuccini historic garden, Cagliari: A green pause that changes the pace after the historic streets. Allow about 45 minutes (editorial estimate). Check the public gate and current garden access.
